capabilities: Builds a home dashboard of project cards with health, due dates and activity sparklines
Creates project pages with Activity, Meetings, Tasks and Notes tabs
Generates session notes listing done and open tasks automatically
Logs agent updates as small Markdown files via log-update.sh
Archives and restores projects by moving their folders
disambiguation: Not limited to home projects; 'Home' is the dashboard note, and projects in any area can be tracked.
extras: Not yet on the community plugin list; install via BRAT or manually. A sample vault with seven fictional projects is included.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in project dashboard, meetings lose their tasks, and coding agents have no standard format for logging progress into a vault.

relations.evidence: The Tasks plugin adds that date automatically when you check a task.
Claude Code, Codex or any script can log progress with the included log-update.sh.

summary: Dashboard and project pages built from plain Markdown notes, with an activity feed, session notes that carry tasks forward, and agent-friendly updates.
